detail:
Full summary: Triage spec §5.1 shared-code prerequisites (PR-stage 1): extracted computeResolvedIds into src/engine/resolution.ts and scopeMatches into src/utils/scope.ts; refactored archiver.ts + blackboard.ts auto-archive count onto the shared resolution helper, and the scope-filter sites in decision-store, blackboard-store, handoff-store, and sqlite-stores onto scopeMatches. Added verify.ts cross-reference comment (checkWarnings stays type-discriminating per spec). New unit tests test/resolution.test.ts + test/scope.test.ts. Full suite 1301 passed / 2 skipped, build clean.
Decisions: Chose to also refactor sqlite-stores.ts's three byte-identical scope-match sites onto scopeMatches, beyond the spec §5.1 list of the three file-backend stores — leaving the v2-default backend with parallel copies is exactly the drift the extraction targets; mechanical, behavior-preserving, guarded by the sqlite parity suite. Deviation-with-reason from the task's three-store enumeration.; Preserved handoff-store's optional-scope behavior via scopeMatches(e.scope ?? "", filterScope) — verified equivalent to the original e.scope?.startsWith(filterScope) || filterScope.startsWith(e.scope ?? "") because the filter is truthy-guarded (filterScope never empty), so an undefined entry scope still matches everything.; Kept decision-store/sqlite getByScope affected_files matching on scopeMatches too (same bidirectional rule, pure function) while leaving affected_symbols as strict equality — no behavior change.
